name: Adtech Systems Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Adtech Systems Ltd is an electronic system integrator and provides solutions in electronic security systems. It also provides solutions in Solar Projects[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
ASL is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company providing integrated electronic security systems and solutions. With over 15 support centers, ASL has completed 10,000+ security installations for 4,000+ customers across India. The company specializes in the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of electronic security systems and floating structures. ASL is also involved in solar projects.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 30.7%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 8.46% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 29.7% of their holding.
